note: Complete no-artifact diagnostic assembly on three default repetitions of the same full real-source scan/map. Both policies already skip unused ICP normals and share map loading and its NN reference. The candidate borrows the loaded/preprocessed input for no-op downsampling; independent initial-transform and working registration copies remain. Both paths execute loading, copies, native NN preparation/search, statistics, report assembly and cleanup; a saved actual full-source ICP result is supplied at the native solver boundary after actual preparation. Live ICP iterations, artifact/PLY work, tracing/hashing/writes and CLI writes are excluded. No generated/perturbed/newly thinned geometry or independent drive-frame or recorded SLAM telemetry claim. A traced parity pair, excluded first pair and one warm-up pair precede five default alternating timed pairs. Warmed pages; no cold-ingestion, peak RSS, full ICP/SLAM runtime or GPU speed claim. All observations remain.
